status: Draft task content preserved while the tracked plan workflow is unavailable; not a finalized PLAN or approval gate.

tasks.title: Classify every supported driver's editable and secret fields
tasks.summary: Inspect actual driver/config/converter reads and persist a per-kind matrix with public editable fields, credential slots, retained-only fields and rejected legacy shapes, including recursive/partitioning and all supported options. This is a design-input task; do not implement projection/materialization until it has no unclassified fields.
acceptanceChecks: Every runtime listRegisteredKinds entry maps to a source-backed row and fixture; unknown secret-bearing fields fail closed.
Pinned-family and URL/path dialect compatibility is explicit; matrix is a reviewed build input, not a family-wide secrecy assumption.

tasks.title: Declare v2 protocol and typed management envelope
tasks.summary: Create proposed src/shared/connection-management.ts with sc1/sc2/sc3/sc8 declaration types; extend ConnectionsFile with an optional envelope while preserving ConnectionConfig and unknown fields.
acceptanceChecks: Strict types compile with NodeNext and exact optional properties; existing saved documents remain readable.
Typed converter schema/worksheet identity, operation tickets, safe errors and context/lease declarations match the approved LLD.

tasks.title: Implement driver profiles and safe draft materialization
tasks.summary: Create proposed src/daemon/db/driver-profiles.ts from the completed matrix; implement safe read projection, server-side patch merge and Keep/Replace/Clear materialization without persistence.
acceptanceChecks: Every supported kind has positive/negative fixtures and no stored secret/ref leaks in safe DTOs.
Unknown supported fields survive label-only edit; identity/kind/family changes reject; cancellation before mutate changes zero bytes/keys.
Explicit legacy pinned family remains effective or is safely read-only, never normalized.

tasks.title: Implement signed operation tickets and request fingerprints
tasks.summary: Add proposed management ticket helpers with persistent signing/HMAC key ownership, canonical target validation, 30-day expiry and full-request keyed fingerprinting.
acceptanceChecks: Malformed/tampered/wrong-target/expired tickets reject without config effects; same operation ID with changed payload is distinguishable.
Key loss on adopted state is recovery-required, not automatic rotation; no plaintext secrets or unkeyed password hashes in receipts/logs.

tasks.title: Implement atomic read-only registry commits and writer fences
tasks.summary: Create proposed src/daemon/db/managed-store.ts atomic writer with exclusive temp, sync, read-only new inode, rename/parent sync, retained metadata and internal gate proof.
acceptanceChecks: Legacy same-UID writeFile after the new digest check gets EACCES and cannot strip envelope; old fd affects detached inode only.
Direct managed saveConnections without gate proof fails; no chmod-to-writable live path.
Uncertain rename/fsync is recoverable rather than presumed rejected; unsupported/privileged permission semantics disable adoption.

tasks.title: Implement immutable credential generations and preparation recovery
tasks.summary: Extend src/daemon/db/secrets.ts and proposed managed-store preparation journal with owned staged references, startup commit-truth checks and retryable cleanup.
acceptanceChecks: Preparation metadata is durable before staging, contains no plaintext, and cleanup never deletes a referenced generation.
Every injected pre/postcommit failure preserves prior effective credentials or reports exact committed/cleanup-pending truth.
Only owned references are cleaned; missing keys or unresolved recovery block new writes.

tasks.title: Implement revision-pinned leases and safe resolver
tasks.summary: Extend src/daemon/db/pool.ts and src/daemon/db/pool-cache.ts with metadata snapshots, tracked full-use callback leases, mutation barriers and idle-close safety; supply future overlay ports without S003 storage.
acceptanceChecks: Saved-only lookupRoot semantics remain intact for unregistered/nested directories; management rights are separate.
New leases reject barriers; active work prevents update/removal; finally release is idempotent and idle close cannot close active use.
No raw Driver escapes callback lifetime; extension seam does not create session state.

tasks.title: Implement serialized saved create/update service
tasks.summary: Create proposed src/daemon/db/management.ts gate; combine profile materialization, revisions, leases extension point, credential staging and atomic commit.
acceptanceChecks: Simultaneous create yields exactly one success; stale/deleted update cannot overwrite/recreate; revisions never reused.
Malformed JSON, invalid shape and non-ENOENT read failures through v2 and legacy paths produce explicit errors with unchanged registry/keychain and zero staging/write calls.
Legacy upsert intent remains atomic but cannot bypass corruption, busy or secret safety gates.

tasks.title: Implement replay/status and activation-only retry
tasks.summary: Implement receipt/inflight join, signed expiry-aware status, pending recovery and revision-targeted activation retry through the saved service.
acceptanceChecks: Same ticket/request replay across restart returns one outcome; changed fingerprint rejects; expired pruned operation cannot replay.
Activation retry makes zero persistence/staging calls and preserves revision/receipt/credential generation.
Refresh failure requires only safe-list retry; never another create.

tasks.title: Migrate data runtime and exploration acquisition aliases
tasks.summary: Migrate src/analyze/runtimes/data/_shared.ts, discovery/schema runtimes, and src/analyze/explore/db-connections-list.ts, src/analyze/explore/db-tables-list.ts and src/analyze/explore/db-table-describe.ts to safe snapshots/leases, including injected seams.
acceptanceChecks: Metadata-only versus driver-use classification matches the source inventory; injected acquire aliases cannot bypass the resolver.
Existing scope-local pool behavior and deterministic outputs pass regression tests.
Table/schema operations retain leases until complete result consumption and release on error.

tasks.title: Migrate measurement and late-work lifetimes
tasks.summary: Migrate src/analyze/measure.ts pending listings and measurement helpers to shared leases retained by underlying work rather than bounded waiters.
acceptanceChecks: Timeout/cancel can return while work remains pending without releasing its lease.
Update/removal remain busy until late success/rejection settles; shared pending work releases exactly once and preserves late-error handling.

tasks.title: Migrate ordinary DB tools and schema-drift lifetimes
tasks.summary: Replace raw acquisition and access-policy metadata lookups in src/daemon/tools/builtins/db/index.ts and src/daemon/tools/builtins/data/schema-drift.ts with safe resolver snapshots/full-use leases.
acceptanceChecks: Every acquireDriver consumer and async iterator keeps full-use ownership; no stream completion/cancel path leaks or releases early.
Driver-internal library pools stay within the outer lease rather than being mistaken for management pools.
Metadata discovery retains safe scoped output and existing authorization semantics.

tasks.title: Define typed memory row sources and shared converter normalization
tasks.summary: Refactor src/daemon/db/drivers/converters/types.ts and shared conversion helpers to expose target catalog, ordered logical/physical types, nullability, normalization and schema-versioned batches while retaining saved conversion APIs.
acceptanceChecks: Empty/all-null data still creates declared schema; no inference from first emitted row.
Worksheet identity/slug and target-aware describe/batches are explicit; saved normalization is reusable, not duplicated lossy code.

tasks.title: Implement bounded BSON and fixed-width memory decoding
tasks.summary: Refactor src/daemon/db/drivers/converters/bson.ts and src/daemon/db/drivers/converters/fixed-width.ts for pre-allocation framing/record limits, cumulative budget and incremental batches.
acceptanceChecks: Oversized BSON length headers fail before payload allocation; no readFile-all; record/depth/field/string limits enforced.
Fixed-width giant records cannot grow an unbounded line buffer; every rejection closes streams and retained state.
Saved/memory typed values and row completeness match on valid fixtures.

tasks.title: Implement bounded Avro memory decoding
tasks.summary: Refactor src/daemon/db/drivers/converters/avro.ts around explicit writer schema and bounded compressed/uncompressed blocks without Parquet destinations in memory mode.
acceptanceChecks: Header/schema/block/expansion admission occurs before collection/materialization; no disk fallback.
Full typed schema/nullability/normalization parity with saved fixtures, including zero rows, is proven.
Over-limit block cleanup releases decoder/inflater buffers.

tasks.title: Implement XLSX bounded archive and parser admission
tasks.summary: Add bounded ZIP/XML admission beneath src/daemon/db/drivers/converters/xlsx.ts, rejecting unsupported expansion/encoding cases before full workbook parsing.
acceptanceChecks: Entry count, declared+actual inflated bytes, retained parser/shared-string state and text/cell units are bounded before retention.
No new Workbook/readFile-all fallback in memory-only path; compressed expansion and malformed metadata fixtures fail cleanly.

tasks.title: Implement XLSX typed worksheet streaming
tasks.summary: Use the bounded archive path to implement target catalog, legacy slug matching, shared-string semantics, two-pass typed inference and empty/all-null worksheet handling.
acceptanceChecks: Target-specific sheet selection and schema cache never cross worksheets; no-target union matches legacy behavior.
Unknown target and divergent schemas fail truthfully; directory-of-XLSX behavior is preserved.
Full saved/memory typed value parity including empty _empty schema is verified.

tasks.title: Implement private memory-only DuckDB execution resources
tasks.summary: Create proposed src/daemon/db/file-execution.ts and extend src/daemon/db/duckdb-pool.ts for private bounded instances, typed appends, validated queries and idempotent disposal.
acceptanceChecks: Memory-only init never INSTALLs extensions or creates spill/profile/cache files; unavailable safe readers fail explicitly.
Typed empty tables, resource budgets and target-specific catalogs work; close/partial failure releases all handles.
Saved singleton API remains compatible and separate.

tasks.title: Thread file execution policy through factory and driver queries
tasks.summary: Update src/daemon/db/drivers/duckdb-file.ts factory/constructor and all query/reader/iterator paths to use the owned FileExecutionResource; expose daemon-internal construction context only.
acceptanceChecks: Every native/converted query uses owned resource callbacks; memory mode cannot invoke persistent ensureCached.
close is no longer a no-op for private resources; target-aware schema cache is scoped correctly.
Legacy transient factory path consumes S001 safe materialization/policy; S002 worker orchestration is not implemented here.

tasks.title: Isolate saved conversion cache identities
tasks.summary: Update src/daemon/db/converter-cache.ts and saved file-driver callers with canonical root/ID/revision/source/options/version identities and content freshness.
acceptanceChecks: Destination, inflight key, sidecar and cleanup use the exact full identity; same-ID roots cannot share data.
Same size/mtime but different contents cannot reuse stale conversion; memory-only routes never touch cache or path logs.
Existing saved cache can be invalidated/rebuilt without touching source files.

tasks.title: Wire v2 management routes and legacy safe projections
tasks.summary: Register capabilities, drivers, safe list/read, ticket/mutate/status/activate in src/daemon/index.ts and src/daemon/db-rpc.ts, with trusted server request context and strict runtime schemas.
acceptanceChecks: Unknown/malformed v2 payloads fail safely; legacy method names/success shapes remain through shared service.
No stored secret/raw option leakage; new-client/old-daemon handshake reports upgrade-required.
No UI, session store, test-worker orchestration or removal UX is added.

tasks.title: Integrate maintenance adoption and fail-closed startup
tasks.summary: Connect owner lease, safe existing daemon-stop control, signing keys, protected snapshots and generation-ref migration to per-root adoption/startup recovery.
acceptanceChecks: Known old PID must be exited and actual target-filesystem fence proof must succeed before adoption advertises mutations.
Root-privileged/unsupported filesystem, unprofiled secret fields, drift, missing key or incomplete recovery keeps feature disabled.
No real registry/keychain is migrated by tests or build validation; downgrade remains stopped and explicit.

tasks.title: Complete regression evidence and enablement gates
tasks.summary: Run required build and focused suites, complete static import/alias/factory classification, failure/restart matrix and shared file fixture checks; record actual evidence and limitations.
acceptanceChecks: All S001 criteria and sc1/sc2/sc3/sc8 tests pass with zero unclassified production acquisition/factory sites.
Cancel equality, unreadable registry, concurrency, late leases, activation-only retry, refresh-only retry and signed-ticket pruning are explicitly evidenced.
Feature remains disabled for any failed target-fence/profile/inventory gate; no claim of completion for sibling stories.

verificationGates: Source-backed per-driver field classification complete before projection/materialization.
Actual deployment filesystem fence proven and known old daemon PID exited before enabling adoption.
scope: S001 only: saved management and shared sc1/sc2/sc3/sc8 foundations. S002-S005 remain separate.
